title: Pull hand-rolled inputs, buttons and bare pages back toward the kit (raw-input ratchet was raised, 190 raw buttons in five builder files, 46 pages with no template shell)

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: scripts/adoption-baselines.json: raw-input baseline 75 (direction raised, 'Create a Space v3 hero builder (create-space-steps) ... added raw inputs'), raw-textarea 3 raised, shadow-literals 47 raised. Raw <input> in 188 places in app/components; worst: app/sign-in/page.tsx 7, app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx 7, app/(main)/connections/new/creator.tsx 7, components/frequency/site/pages/create-space/create-space-steps.tsx 7, app/sign-in/frequency-sign-in.tsx 6. || git grep '<button' in app/components non-test = 2,316 (ratcheted: raw-button-bg baseline 124 lowered, handrolled-icon-button 1, so most are styled via classes). Worst files: components/sites/editor/shell.tsx 74, app/(main)/admin/library/loom-grid.tsx 30, components/journey/v2/journey-editor.tsx 27, components/sites/editor/canvas.tsx 25, entity-blocks/profile-page-builder.tsx 23, builder/shell/builder-shell.tsx 23, app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx 22, components/on-air/session.tsx 20. || scripts/templates-baseline.txt lists 46 entries: wizards (@wizard intercepts, 6 legit), hunts/* 7 (dark), join/(induction) 3, sign-in, app/page.tsx, hosted/[host]/*, admin/{appearance,crm/pipeline,events,walkthroughs}/[id], connections/[id], edit/[slug], scan. 3 are documented gate blind spots.

WHY IT MATTERS: Sign-in and join are the highest-traffic forms and bypass the field primitive (focus ring, error and label wiring). Ratchet is raised so it protects nothing here. Mostly ratcheted and bg-class debt is already low, so this is polish; the join induction flow is the only high-traffic offender. Already ratcheted, set may only shrink. Real candidates are admin detail pages and connections/[id].

FIX DIRECTION: Convert sign-in and induction inputs to components/ui/field, then re-freeze lower. Convert join/induction and on-air buttons to ui/button; leave editor internals. Convert admin/*/[id] and connections/[id] to DetailTemplate/AdminTemplate.

PROGRESS 2026-11-16 (row stays open; three independent draft PRs, none rendered in a browser, so each is limited to changes whose output is provably the same): (1) Inputs: raw-input re-frozen 75 to 66 and raw-textarea 3 to 2, both back to their pre-raise floors. The seven inputs and one textarea in create-space-steps, the upload input in create-space-photos and the lead capture honeypot render through the kit Input and Textarea (seamless). create-space.css is unlayered so it still owns every painted property; one placeholder colour is pinned for the handle field. (2) Buttons: ten raw buttons that already carried the kit class string now render through Button: six in app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx (22 raw buttons to 16), three in admin/library/loom-grid.tsx, one in components/on-air/session.tsx. (3) Templates: baseline 46 to 40. Six pages were gate blind spots whose client view renders AdminTemplate, DetailTemplate or SparkShell on every path; the views are registered compositions. STILL OPEN, and why the probe still fails: it needs raw-input at 60 or lower and 5 or fewer raw buttons in induction.tsx. The remaining text inputs (lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx 2, induction.tsx 6, feature-funnel.tsx 4, app/onboarding/form.tsx 2, app/sign-in/page.tsx 1) carry their own Tailwind chrome: the boxed Input changes height, fill and focus ring, and the seamless one loses its fill to bg-transparent, so each needs a rendered before and after. The other 16 induction buttons are back links, choice tiles and reel dots that match no Button variant. 35 of the 66 remaining raw inputs are range, color, checkbox and radio controls that Input cannot receive. connections/[id], admin/events/[id] and scan need a real template wrap, which is a visible change. 2026-11-16 launch slice (onboarding): the display name and handle fields in app/onboarding/form.tsx render through the kit Input. On the Frequency build the class string is unchanged (`input`, and `input pl-8 pr-9` for the handle), because the form already wore the members kit's `.input`; raw-input re-frozen 66 to 64. Not moved, and why: the text fields in lib/onboarding/step-registry.tsx, app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx and feature-funnel.tsx carry their own Tailwind chrome, and inside the members kit the unlayered `.input` rule would override it, so each needs a signed-in rendered before and after; the hidden and sr-only file inputs are not counted. The raw input in app/sign-in/page.tsx sits on the DAWN branch, which SITE_DESIGN never takes (resolveDesign always returns frequency); the live sign-in form already uses Input. 2026-11-16 induction slice: the six text fields in app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx (both email captures, first and last name, handle, city) render through the kit Input; raw-input re-frozen 64 to 58, so the probe's input half now passes. The live join renders inside SiteShell on the stage surface, where the members .input rule is scoped out (members-ui.css applies it only outside a kit or inside .fq-commons-body), so the inset Tailwind string and the .jx-f rule stay the whole dress. The one surface that does wear .input is the Funnels editor's half-scale operator preview (members kit). STILL OPEN: 16 raw buttons in induction.tsx against a target of 5. Inside the site kit .btn is the 52px iridescent primary pill and there is no quiet text variant, so the five Back links, the two Decide later toggles, the Run it again and Google buttons cannot render through Button without turning into primary pills; choice tiles already use choiceTileClasses, and the reel dots, location options and photo picker match no primitive. Meeting the button target needs a site-kit text button first, or Daniel's phrase to retime the probe.

Closed 2026-11-16. The site kit gains a quiet text action: Button variant ghost (.btn.txt) inside [data-kit=site] is now text weight, no fill, a 44px tap floor and a -12px inline margin so the label sits flush; before it painted as a second primary pill. On it, the five Back links, both Decide later toggles and the photo picker render through Button; Run it again and Continue with Google render as Button secondary; the name hint is IconButton with the Info glyph. induction.tsx 16 raw buttons to 5 (three choice-tile groups on choiceTileClasses, the reel dots and the city options stay). Rendered locally through a SiteShell harness at 390 and 1280, beats 0 to 3: Back links grow from 33x21 to 57x44 and sit about 11px lower; text stays 15px in the muted tone; the name hint grows from a 17px glyph to the 44px kit icon control. Left open by design, not by this row: inputs in step-registry, feature-funnel and the 35 range/color/checkbox controls, and the connections/[id], admin/events/[id] and scan template wraps.

verify.note: Passes 2026-11-16: raw-input 58 (<=60), 5 raw buttons in induction.tsx (<=5), templates-baseline 40 (<=40).
